name: create_framing_system
description: Create a structural beam system filling a rectangular boundary (mm, project coordinates) on a level: beams at a fixed center-to-center spacing running along X or Y. Beam type picked by name substring, else the first loaded structural framing type; level by name, else the active plan view's level, else the lowest level. Simplified from the source: rectangular boundary and fixed-distance layout only, beams sit at the level. Requires a loaded beam family. Returns beam system id, beam ids and count.

params.name: x_min_mm
params.description: Minimum X of the rectangular boundary in mm.

params.name: x_max_mm
params.description: Maximum X of the rectangular boundary in mm.

params.name: y_min_mm
params.description: Minimum Y of the rectangular boundary in mm.

params.name: y_max_mm
params.description: Maximum Y of the rectangular boundary in mm.

params.name: direction
params.description: Beam span direction: 'x' (beams parallel to the X axis) or 'y'.

params.name: level_name
params.description: Level name, case-insensitive exact match. Omit to use the active plan view's level, else the lowest level.

params.name: beam_type_name
params.description: Substring matched against structural framing 'Family: Type' names, e.g. 'UB305' or 'W12'. Omit to use the first loaded type.

params.name: justify
params.description: Where the first beam sits relative to the boundary: 'beginning', 'center' (default) or 'end'.
